verses.1: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.2: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
verses.3: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.5: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.6: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
verses.7: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.8: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.9: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.10: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
